why: The config/policy.json prepare-drive writes without the Kit switch, per twin: a DIY drive (no posture flag) and a dev drive (-Dev / --dev). These are the bytes the twins wrote before the update keys existed (prepare-drive.ps1 and prepare-drive.sh of commit 7c969583, run with no flag and with the dev flag): -Kit / --kit adds the updates block to a Kit only, and no change made for it may move a byte of these (F-8, the T3.1 review R1-4). The prepare-drive rows of script-orchestration.test.ts compare each written file with its text here, byte for byte; the parsed-JSON rows beside them cannot see whitespace, key order or a final newline. A deliberate change of a posture updates this file.
